change: Emergency unity government + war cabinet formed: Netanyahu (PM), Gallant (Defense), Gantz (National Unity) join; Eisenkot as observer.
Saleh al-Arouri (deputy political bureau chief) killed in Israeli strike in Beirut dahiya.
President Ebrahim Raisi and FM Amir-Abdollahian die in helicopter crash; Masoud Pezeshkian elected president July 5 2024 (inaugurated July 30).
Benny Gantz and Gadi Eisenkot quit the emergency government over lack of 'day after' plan; war cabinet dissolved June 17 2024.
Mohammed Deif, Qassam Brigades commander, killed in Khan Younis strike (IDF confirmed Aug 1 2024). De facto successor as military chief: Mohammed Sinwar.
Fuad Shukr, top military commander, killed in Israeli strike on Beirut dahiya (response to Majdal Shams massacre).

Ismail Haniyeh, political bureau chief, assassinated in Tehran (IRGC guesthouse bombing attributed to Israel). Yahya Sinwar named political bureau chief Aug 6 2024 - uniting Gaza and overall leadership.
Hassan Nasrallah, secretary-general since 1992, killed in massive IAF strike on Beirut dahiya HQ (with IRGC Gen. Abbas Nilforoushan).
Hashem Safieddine, presumptive successor, killed in strike on underground HQ (confirmed by Hezbollah Oct 23 2024). Naim Qassem elected secretary-general Oct 29 2024; still SG as of Aug 2026.

Yahya Sinwar killed by IDF troops in chance encounter in Tel al-Sultan, Rafah. Succeeded by a 5-member leadership council; Khalil al-Hayya leads negotiations from Doha; Mohammed Sinwar de facto Gaza leader.
Netanyahu fires Defense Minister Yoav Gallant; Israel Katz becomes defense minister (Gideon Sa'ar to foreign ministry).
Assad regime falls; Bashar al-Assad flees to Moscow. HTS leader Ahmed al-Sharaa (al-Julani) leads transition; named interim president Jan 29 2025; still president Aug 2026.
Donald Trump inaugurated (succeeding Biden). Marco Rubio SoS; Steve Witkoff special envoy (Gaza/Iran files); Adam Boehler hostage envoy; Mike Huckabee ambassador to Israel.
Itamar Ben Gvir (Otzma Yehudit) quits coalition over Gaza ceasefire; returns March 19 2025 after war resumes. Remains national security minister through Aug 2026.
Lt. Gen. Herzi Halevi resigns as IDF chief of staff over Oct 7 responsibility (announced Jan 21 2025); Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir sworn in March 5 2025.

Mohammed Sinwar, Gaza military leader, killed in strike on tunnel under European Hospital, Khan Younis (confirmed by Israel May 28 and Hamas later). Succeeded by Izz al-Din al-Haddad as Gaza commander (from ~June 1-3 2025).

Israeli Operation Rising Lion decapitation strikes: killed IRGC CG Hossein Salami, AF chief of staff Mohammad Bagheri, IRGC Aerospace cdr Amir Ali Hajizadeh, Gen. Gholamali Rashid, intel chief Mohammad Kazemi, and 9+ nuclear scientists. Replacements: Mohammad Pakpour (IRGC), Abdolrahim Mousavi (AF chief of staff).

United Torah Judaism (July 14-16) and Shas (July 16-17) quit the government over failure to pass Haredi draft-exemption law; Shas stays inside coalition without portfolios. Coalition becomes minority-adjacent but survives; neither returns to full government posts through Aug 2026.

Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei assassinated in joint US-Israeli strikes (Op. Epic Fury / Lion's Roar) on Tehran; also killed: IRGC CG Mohammad Pakpour and DM Aziz Nasirzadeh. President Pezeshkian survives assassination attempt. Targets also included Mousavi, Shamkhani, Larijani.

Assembly of Experts (convened Mar 3-8 amid leadership crisis) names Mojtaba Khamenei, 56, son of Ali Khamenei, as third Supreme Leader; announced Mar 9 2026. Pezeshkian remains president and signs June 17 Versailles MOU with Trump.

Izz al-Din al-Haddad, Gaza military-wing commander ('last architect of Oct 7'), killed in Israeli strike on Gaza City apartment. Successor as Gaza commander not clearly established publicly as of Aug 2026; political file remains with Khalil al-Hayya's Doha-based leadership.

25th Knesset dissolves at end of summer session per coalition dissolution bills (preliminary reading 110-0, first reading 106-0, June 2026) amid Haredi draft crisis; elections set for Oct 27 2026 (first Knesset to complete a ~full term since 1988; a September date was floated but Oct 27 stands). Netanyahu remains PM of transition government through election.
